Upper Text: [On Play] [On Deletion] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP until the end of their turn.

[End of Opponent’s Turn] By deleting this Digimon, you may play 1 [Rosemon] or [Jijimon] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, activate the [When Digivolving] effects of the Digimon this effect played.
